{{Current events|year=2025|month=11|day=30|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza War]]
**[[Palestinian tunnel warfare in the Gaza Strip]]
***The [[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] claims to have killed more than 40 [[Hamas]] militants over the past week who attempted to exit a tunnel in eastern [[Rafah]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/israeli-army-says-killed-four-terrorists-in-gaza-s-rafah-5e40e216 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***One person is killed and 19 others are injured overnight after a [[Russia]]n strike on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/russia-launches-deadly-strike-kyiv-zelenskyy-travels-dc/story?id=127976448 (ABC News)]
*[[Republican insurgency in Afghanistan]]
**The [[Afghanistan Freedom Front]] claims that its fighters killed three [[Taliban]] soldiers and wounded two more in a rocket attack in [[Badakhshan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.afintl.com/en/202511300513 (Afghanistan International)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Ditwah]]
***The toll from the [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rains in [[Sri Lanka]] increases to 334 people killed and about 400 more missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/30/neighbourhoods-buried-under-mud-sri-lanka-floods-death-toll-rises-to-159 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Cyclone Senyar]]
***The toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Indonesia]] increases to 442 people killed and 402 more missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/30/indonesia-floods-death-toll-rises-to-442-as-people-hunt-for-food-and-water (Al Jazeera)]
*Eleven people are killed after two buses collide near [[Sivaganga]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]]. [https://www.theweek.in/news/india/2025/11/30/sivaganga-bus-crash-11-dead-as-two-state-buses-collide-tamil-nadu-cm-stalin-announces-aid.html (''The Week'')]
*Five people are killed in a [[Structure fire|house fire]] in [[Neuves-Maisons]], [[Meurthe-et-Moselle]], [[France]]. [https://apnews.com/article/france-home-blaze-477e383a45cf4bcfa02d6692ea64c68e (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Philippine anti-corruption protests]], [[Flood control projects scandal in the Philippines]]
**[[Trillion Peso March]]
***Massive protests denouncing [[Corruption in the Philippines|corruption]] over the ongoing [[flood control]] scandal are held across the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/philippines-thousands-protest-corruption-in-flood-projects/a-74956055 (DW)]  [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2025/11/30/2490908/live-updates-anti-corruption-protests-november-30 (''The Philippine Star'')]
*[[2025 Honduran general election]]
**[[Hondurans]] vote for [[President of Honduras|their president]] to succeed term-limited incumbent [[Xiomara Castro]]. [https://apnews.com/article/honduras-election-trump-moncada-nasralla-asfura-5c9bc8331d1f586c0f200f6f6303127a (AP)]
*[[2025 Swiss referendums#November referendums|November 2025 Swiss referendums]]
**[[Swiss people|Swiss]] voters reject two ballot measures to [[conscription in Switzerland|conscript]] women into a national service program and to establish an [[inheritance tax]] on high earners. [https://apnews.com/article/switzerland-national-service-44e23e7d0579058f2bc69dd9ce7e655d (AP)]
*[[2025 Kyrgyz parliamentary election]]
**[[Kyrgyz]] vote for the members of the [[Supreme Council (Kyrgyzstan)|Supreme Council]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/30/kyrgyzstan-votes-in-snap-parliamentary-election-with-no-opposition (''Al Jazeera'')]
*[[2025 Transnistrian parliamentary election]]
**[[Transnistrians]] vote for the members of the [[Supreme Council (Transnistria)|Supreme Council]] of the unrecognized republic of [[Transnistria]]. [https://odessa-journal.com/foreign-intelligence-service-transnistria-elections-mark-record-low-turnout-complete-control-by-sheriff-linked-party (''Odessa-Journal'')]
*Thousands of supporters of [[Spain]]'s [[conservatism|conservative]] and [[Christian democratic]] opposition [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]] gather in [[Madrid]] and calls for [[Prime Minister of Spain|prime minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] to resign amid a [[Koldo case|corruption scandal]] involving ruling [[PSOE]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/spain-thousands-of-protesters-call-for-sanchez-to-resign-amid-corruption-allegations/a-74960049 (AP)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
